title: Activity Selection
definition: Given N activities with start and end times, select the maximum number of activities that don't overlap. The Greedy choice is to always pick the activity that ENDS earliest, leaving the most time for others.
simpleExplanation: Trying to attend as many meetings as possible. Always pick the meeting that finishes the fastest so your schedule frees up.

answers.question: **Basic:** Identify the core logic required to implement Activity Selection.
**Intermediate 1:** Solve a standard problem using Activity Selection in O(N log N) or O(N) time.
**Intermediate 2:** Adapt Activity Selection to handle strings or distinct objects instead of numbers.
**Advanced:** Use Activity Selection to solve a complex sub-array or sub-string problem (e.g. Longest non-repeating).
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize Activity Selection to achieve strictly O(1) space constraints while maintaining linear time.
